summary: The test compiles and runs without errors and uses Playwright APIs correctly. However, the selector used to click the product and the URL assertion are somewhat weak and may not reliably verify the correct product detail page. The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is valid but may be brittle if data-test attributes change. The URL assertion using a regex on /product/ is too generic and does not confirm the exact product page loaded. Test title preserves the testCaseId. There are no asynchronous assertion issues. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs are present. The test is minimal and lacks assertions on critical page content, reducing assertion strength.

issues.description: Selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is used but may be brittle if data-test attributes change.
issues.recommendation: Consider using more robust selectors or adding fallback locators with more context.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regex (/product/) which does not confirm the exact product detail page loaded.
issues.recommendation: Use a more specific URL or additional assertions on page content to verify the correct product detail page.

recommendations: Enhance the URL assertion to verify the specific product ID or name is present in the path or query.
Add assertions verifying key elements on the product detail page (e.g., product title, price, description) to strengthen test reliability.
Consider extracting selectors to constants or helper functions for better reusability and maintainability.
